verification.method: A retained historical execution summary records a restricted-unconfirmed observation after an opted-in master restart with an unavailable ready member, an authority-write refusal, continuity of an unrelated running VM process, and clearing after the member returned ready. It remains historical context only because its raw mutation data and bounded samples are not retained. The later bounded rerun's earlier autostart/no-escape limit is superseded by reviewed timed-autostart suppression/restoration and a UI/source audit that found no force, override, declare-lost or timeout control; together they pass the exact S6-18 CHECKPLAN scope. Duplicate-writer safety, package installation, permanently-dead-member recovery and Phase 4 acceptance remain unclaimed.
